edition.name: Migne, Patrologia Latina 5 (1844), via Latin Wikisource
edition.witness_note: Single locked witness in repo; second witness not yet locked.

source_text: Dat tuba coelo signum, sublato leone; Et fiunt subito tenebrae cum coeli fragore. Summittit oculos Dominus ut terra tremiscat; Adclamat ut et audiant omnes in orbem: Ecce diu tacui sufferens tanto tempore vestra. Conclamant pariter plangentes sero gementes; Ululatur, ploratur, nec spatium datur iniquis. Lactanti quid faciet mater? cum ipsa crematur. In flamma ignis Dominus judicabit iniquos: Justos autem non tanget ignis, sed immo delinget. Sub uno morantur, sed pars in sententia flevit. Tantus erit ardor, ut lapides ipsi liquescant; In fulmina coeunt venti, furit ira coelestis, Ut quacumque fugit impius, occupatur ab igne. Suppetium nullum erit, nec nautica puppis: Flammat Amen gentes, et Medi Parthique fervent In annis mille, ut ferunt operta Joannis. Nam inde post annos mille gehennae traduntur, Et fabrica cujus erant, cum ipse cremantur.
pass_a_gloss: The trumpet gives a sign to heaven, with the lion removed; And suddenly darknesses happen with a crash of the heaven. The Lord lowers His eyes so that the earth may tremble; He cries out so that all may hear in the world: Behold, I have been silent for a long time, suffering your things. They cry out together, lamenting, groaning late; It is howled, it is wept, and no space is given to the wicked. What will the nursing mother do? when she herself is being burned. The Lord will judge the wicked in the flame of fire: But the fire will not touch the just, rather it will cleanse them. They die under one, but part of the sentence has wept. The heat will be so great, that even the stones themselves will melt; The winds come together in lightning, the heavenly anger rages, So that wherever the impious person flees, she is seized by the fire. There will be no assistance, nor a ship's stern: The nations are inflamed, and the Medes and Parthians are fervent In the thousand years, as the secrets of John reveal. For from then on, after a thousand years, they are handed over to Gehenna, And the thing they were made of, when they themselves are being burned.

choices.english: when she herself is being burned

pass_b_english: The trumpet signals heaven with the lion removed, and suddenly darkness falls with a crash from the sky. The Lord lowers his eyes so the earth trembles; he cries out so all may hear across the world: "Behold, I have stayed silent a long time, enduring your deeds." They cry out together, lamenting, groaning too late; there is howling, there is weeping, and no space is given to the wicked. What will the nursing mother do when she herself is being burned? The Lord will judge the wicked in the flame of fire, but the fire will not touch the just; rather it will cleanse them. They die under one judgment, but part of the sentence has wept. The heat will be so great that even the stones melt; the winds gather in lightning, heavenly anger rages, so that wherever the impious person flees, fire seizes her. There will be no help, no ship's stern: the nations are inflamed, and the Medes and Parthians burn in the thousand years, as the secrets of John reveal (Revelation 20:11-15). For from then on, after a thousand years, they are handed over to Gehenna, and the substance they were made of burns when they themselves are being burned.
